name: Flatlay fans beside a size-by-size grid
looks: A headline with one italic word lands beside a small fan of overlapping product photos. To its right a 2x2 grid of size cards pops in, each with a short label and a piece count, a thumbnail of two garments pinned to the corner of the bottom pair. A green checkmark line confirms a total count beneath it.
build: variant-stack-reveal for both the photo fan (seeded rotation/offset) and the size-card grid (uneven 10-30% stagger, settling square); the checkmark line fades/slides in last, after the grid finishes.
sound: A soft shutter click per photo, a cluster of ticks as the grid lands, and a confirm chime on the checkmark line.
prompt: Show a product organising physical items by category: fan a few photos of real items beside a small grid of labelled groups, each tagged with a count, and close on a single confirmation line proving everything was accounted for.
